general_configuration.dataset_split: 100 train / 20 val videos per class (Total: 200 train, 40 val videos)
general_configuration.frame_sampling_strategy: 5 frames per video at uniform fractions [0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9]
general_configuration.video_level_aggregation_method: Average frame probability (soft voting) thresholded at 0.5

pilot2_baseline.configuration: EfficientNet-B0 backbone (frozen) + custom classifier head. lr=0.001

pilot3_best_model.configuration: EfficientNet-B0 backbone (unfrozen, fine-tuned). Includes data augmentation (RandomHorizontalFlip, ColorJitter).
